description: This file defines classes and functions for managing Firefox protocol connections within the Playwright testing framework, including connection handling, session management, message dispatching, and event handling.

classes.name: FFConnection
classes.description: Manages the WebSocket connection to the Firefox browser, handles message sending and receiving, and manages sessions.

classes.name: FFSession
classes.description: Represents a protocol session within the Firefox connection, manages command dispatch, message handling, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: nextMessageId
methods.description: Generates the next message ID for protocol communication.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a raw protocol message through the transport.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, dispatching them to the appropriate session.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles the closing of the connection, cleaning up resources and emitting a disconnect event.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if it is not already closed.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new protocol session with a specified session ID.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command and returns a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a protocol command, logs errors if it fails, and returns a promise.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches an incoming protocol message to the appropriate callback or event.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, rejecting all pending commands and cleaning up.
